§6TWENTY-FIVE NODES, 112 POINTS, AND YOU CAN CHANGE YOUR MIND§r
The milestone lines pay progression points. This is the only thing that spends them.

§5§lWHERE IT IS§r
Open the §9controller§r - the Nuclear Plant Foundation itself, not a control block - and look at the bottom right of its GUI. Left of the three small number fields there is a small §9chart button§r. Click it and the tree opens on its own panel, centred on the screen over the GUI; click it again, or its X, to close. Hovering it says §8Upgrade Tree§r.
§8The number fields have not moved. Build Tier is still the narrow one, then RPM Limit, then control rods on the far right.§r

§5§lTHE SHAPE OF IT§r
One free root - §9Plant Commissioning§r, 0 points - and four branches hanging off it, §6one per milestone line§r, six nodes deep:

  §9UPTIME§r branch        water, steam buffer, baseload output
  §9BURNUP§r branch        rod seals, recladding, deeper burns, more rods withdrawn
  §9ORE PROCESSING§r branch  solvent recovery, an extra leach tank, module automation
  §9TURBINE§r branch       rotor balancing, bearings, nozzles, overspeed certification

A node needs the node above it on the same branch, and §6a node at depth N on a branch needs THAT branch's milestone line at tier N§r. One rule, no table: the branch that rewards your turbine is the branch the TURBINE line opens.

The four deepest nodes also each need a depth-4 node from the NEXT branch round, so the end of the tree forces breadth. You cannot rush one branch to the bottom and ignore the other three.

§5BUYING AND REFUNDING§r
§9Left-click§r a node to buy it. §9Right-click§r to refund it. The button's own tooltip says so: §8Left-click a node to buy it, right-click to refund. Refunds are free, unlimited, and refused only when another node you hold hangs off it.§r

§2Refunds cost nothing and there is no limit on them.§r Every point goes back the moment you hand a node back, so the tree is somewhere to experiment rather than a decision you regret for the rest of the campaign. The one refusal is the obvious one: you cannot refund a node that something you still hold is hanging off. Refund the far end of the branch first.

Hover any node for its full story - title, effect, cost, what it needs, which milestone tier opens it, and §6exactly which one requirement is currently failing§r. There is no second window to open.

§5WHAT THE NODES ACTUALLY DO§r
A node moves one of twelve numbers, and only those twelve: plant output, the control-rod cap, feedwater condensate stages, the steam buffer, cycle RPM gain, the turbine redline, rotor life, Derrick and Annex cycle speed, Annex batch size, the Derrick's tantalum interval, heat rejection, and the decay-heat window. Every one of them starts at a value that does nothing, and every node only ever moves it in your favour.

Bought in full the tree is worth §2x1.450§r on plant output on top of the milestone term, §2+6§r on the control-rod cap, §2x1.30§r on the redline with §2x1.40§r on the cycle gain to reach it, §2x1.75§r on rotor life and §2x1.50§r on both process modules.

§6The tree pays for itself in the right order.§r The rod nodes push the control-rod cap past 24/24, which raises steam - and therefore feedwater. The same tree's condensate nodes cut that feedwater draw by two more halvings. The water branch pays for the fuel branch.

§5§lDO THIS§r
§91.§r Earn a milestone tier on any line. That is 1 point.
§92.§r Open the tree and buy §9Plant Commissioning§r. It is free and it has no effect - it is the certificate that opens everything else.
§93.§r Buy the depth-1 node on whichever branch you just opened.

§2§lDONE WHEN§r
You tick it, once the tree is open in front of you.

§8A TICK BOX on purpose: nodes are bought with points, not with items, and no quest can read what you have bought.§r

[note]The panel roll-up reads §8Upgrades 0/25§r, then §80/112 points committed§r, then how many you have §8available§r. Under it, §8Tree effects: none - nothing purchased, the plant runs stock§r until you buy something - after which it lists exactly which of the twelve numbers you have moved, and by how much. The controller GUI, both control blocks, the scanner and the tree panel all print that from the same code, so they cannot disagree.[/note]

[warn]The tree is bought with points the four milestone lines paid out, and the whole tree costs exactly what a full sweep of all four lines pays: 112. Nothing is wasted and nothing falls short - but you will be choosing between branches for a long time before you can afford all of them.[/warn]
